model.olist_analytics.fct_orders.name: fct_orders
model.olist_analytics.fct_orders.description: One row per order: status, amounts, delivery time, late flag and review score. The Power BI and Tableau dashboards read this table.

order_id.name: order_id
order_id.description: Primary key. **Orders**: distinct count of `order_id` among delivered orders.

customer_id.name: customer_id
customer_id.description: Customer identifier of this order only.

is_delivered.name: is_delivered
is_delivered.description: True when order_status is 'delivered', the scope of every KPI.

order_purchased_at.name: order_purchased_at
order_purchased_at.description: When the customer placed the order.

order_delivered_carrier_at.name: order_delivered_carrier_at
order_delivered_carrier_at.description: When the seller handed the order to the carrier.

order_delivered_customer_at.name: order_delivered_customer_at
order_delivered_customer_at.description: When the customer received the order.

order_estimated_delivery_at.name: order_estimated_delivery_at
order_estimated_delivery_at.description: Delivery date promised to the customer at purchase.

items_count.name: items_count
items_count.description: Number of items of the order, 0 for orders without items.

items_revenue_brl.name: items_revenue_brl
items_revenue_brl.description:
**Revenue (BRL)**: sum of the item prices (`price`) of the order, shipping excluded.
The KPI only counts delivered orders (`is_delivered = true`). **Average basket (BRL)**: revenue divided by the number of orders, computed after
aggregation. Never an average of per-order averages.

freight_value_brl.name: freight_value_brl
freight_value_brl.description:
**Freight (BRL)**: sum of the shipping costs (`freight_value`) of the order items.
Same scope as revenue: delivered orders only.

payment_value_brl.name: payment_value_brl
payment_value_brl.description: Total paid by the customer in BRL, shipping and vouchers included.

payment_count.name: payment_count
payment_count.description: Number of payments of the order.

payment_installments.name: payment_installments
payment_installments.description: Largest number of instalments among the payments.

main_payment_type.name: main_payment_type
main_payment_type.description: Type of the payment with the largest amount.

review_id.name: review_id
review_id.description: Review kept for the order, the most recently answered one.

review_score.name: review_score
review_score.description:
**Average review score (1 to 5)**: average of `review_score`, with one review per order: the
most recently answered one. An order can receive several reviews, and counting all of them
would weigh some orders twice.

review_count.name: review_count
review_count.description: Number of reviews the order received, 0 when none.

delivery_days.name: delivery_days
delivery_days.description:
**Delivery time (days)**: calendar days between the purchase date and the date the customer
received the order. Only for delivered orders with both dates known: 8 delivered orders have
no delivery date and are left out.

is_late.name: is_late
is_late.description:
**Late delivery rate**: delivered orders received after the estimated delivery date, compared
day by day, divided by delivered orders. `is_late` is false for orders that were not delivered
or whose delivery date is unknown.

model.olist_analytics.dim_dates.name: dim_dates
model.olist_analytics.dim_dates.description: One row per day from 2016-01-01 to 2018-12-31, built with dbt_utils.date_spine.

month_start.name: month_start
month_start.description: First day of the month, for monthly trends.

iso_day_of_week.name: iso_day_of_week
iso_day_of_week.description: Day of the week, from 1 (Monday) to 7 (Sunday).

model.olist_analytics.stg_olist__orders.name: stg_olist__orders

customer_id.description: Customer of this order only; see stg_olist__customers.customer_unique_id.

order_purchased_at.name: order_purchased_at

order_delivered_carrier_at.name: order_delivered_carrier_at
order_delivered_carrier_at.description: When the seller handed the order to the carrier.

order_delivered_customer_at.name: order_delivered_customer_at
order_delivered_customer_at.description: When the customer received the order.

order_estimated_delivery_at.name: order_estimated_delivery_at
order_estimated_delivery_at.description: Delivery date promised to the customer at purchase.
